description: Spaced Practice Engine (/practice) - A dedicated spaced repetition page for daily question practice. Shows one question at a time with immediate reveal, SM-2-like algorithm for scheduling, and per-question history tracking. Also includes Question Annotations (notes on questions). This is the CORE daily study tool.
steps: Create src/features/practice/ directory with types/, utils/, components/ subdirs

Create src/features/practice/types/index.ts with PracticeHistory interface: { questionId: string, lastSeen: string (ISO), timesCorrect: number, timesWrong: number, easeFactor: number, interval: number, nextDue: string (ISO) }. Also PracticeStats: { practicedToday: number, streak: number, dueTomorrow: number }

Create src/features/practice/utils/practice-storage.ts: functions to read/write localStorage key 'cfa-buddy-practice-history' (Record<questionId, PracticeHistory>). Also track daily practice count and streak in 'cfa-buddy-practice-stats' ({date: string, count: number, streakDays: number, lastPracticeDate: string}). Use lazy initializer pattern (if typeof window === 'undefined' return default).

Create src/features/practice/utils/practice-algorithm.ts: selectNextQuestion() function that picks from all questions (via loadAllQuestions from question-bank/utils/question-loader.ts) using spaced repetition logic: (1) 80% of picks from due questions (nextDue <= now), sorted by overdueness, weighted by subject weakness; (2) 20% new (never-seen) questions. Also include updatePracticeHistory() that takes questionId + rating ('forgot'|'hard'|'good'|'easy') and updates easeFactor/interval/nextDue using SM-2 logic (similar to flashcards/utils/sm2.ts but adapted for questions).

Create src/features/practice/utils/annotations-storage.ts: functions to read/write localStorage key 'cfa-buddy-question-notes' (Record<questionId, string>). Functions: getNotes(), getNote(questionId), saveNote(questionId, note), deleteNote(questionId), searchNotes(query) returning {questionId, note}[].

Create src/features/practice/components/practice-content.tsx: Main client component. State: currentQuestion, showAnswer, practiceHistory, stats. Loads a question via selectNextQuestion(). Shows question text + answer choices (not selectable initially). 'Reveal Answer' button shows correct answer highlighted. After reveal, shows 4 rating buttons: Forgot / Hard / Good / Easy with color coding. Updates history on rating click, then loads next question. Shows stats bar at top: 'Practiced today: X | Streak: Y days | Due tomorrow: Z'. Include inline note/annotation input (small icon that expands to textarea, max 500 chars) that saves to cfa-buddy-question-notes.
Create src/features/practice/components/practice-question-card.tsx: Reusable card showing question text, answer choices (revealed state shows green/red), explanation, and annotation note if exists.
Create src/app/(protected)/practice/page.tsx: Server component that renders PracticeContent (no auth needed, just wraps the client component).
Add 'Practice' to navigation in src/shared/config/navigation.ts: { name: 'Practice', href: '/practice', icon: Repeat } (import Repeat from lucide-react). Place it after 'Questions' in the list.

Integrate annotations into search: In src/features/search/components/search-modal.tsx, add a section that searches question notes (from cfa-buddy-question-notes localStorage key) and returns them as type 'note' results with href to /practice.

Ensure all components use CSS variables for theming (var(--card-bg), var(--card-border), var(--foreground), etc.), are mobile responsive, and use no external libraries beyond what's already in package.json.
acceptance_criteria: /practice route renders and shows a question
Clicking 'Reveal Answer' shows the correct answer highlighted green with explanation
Rating buttons (Forgot/Hard/Good/Easy) update localStorage and load next question
Stats bar shows practiced today count, streak, and due tomorrow count
Practice navigation item appears in sidebar after Questions
Annotations can be added to questions and persist in localStorage
Annotations appear in Cmd+K search results
npm test passes all existing tests
